title: A Redeeming Duel
author: Mukul Kumar
text:
Dusk :
Darkness is filling in the woods,
Night is gathering in the mind,
But light is not suffusing the heart,
Dreams are not awakening,
as I turn to wilderness in the woodland.
Darkness darkens, black, blacker,
Life-size and lurid,
Sysiphus looms,
As Nemesis rises,
and life it dooms.
Sun is certain to rise tomorrow,
But do I wish another morrow?
Death-sleep may light up a dream,
Hope glows, scattering its gleam.
But like a twin is born the question
To be or not to be….
Preferable are the ills
we know to others
we know not of?
As Sisyphus and Shakespeare
are locked into friction,
a glimmer of life lights up the heart.
